title: The local completed Chern class reduces to the finite positive Kummer class
statement: Let l be prime, Y and P=ProjectiveLine Y Noetherian schemes with DiagonalTraceLocalizations, and let s be UniformizerChernNormalizationData l Y [def-diagonal-uniformizer-chern-transport]. Retain its local coefficient data at P [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-quotient-line, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-realization] and its normalized strict Chern data [def-sp-tower-class-chern, def-sfb-diagonal-trace-coefficients, def-sfb-diagonal-trace-presentation]. Use the constructed endpoints [def-diagonal-uniformizer-local-endpoints]: localFunctor is completed realization on P, integral extension, quotient extension, and finite realization. Define localUnit as the composite of their four unit endpoints and localLine as the composite of their four shifted positive-line endpoints. localUnit is invertible. For z:completedUnit(P)→completedLine(P)[2], assume its constant-scalar restriction followed by the shifted root-limit comparison equals coefficientsX.unitMap followed by LX of restrictionX(firstChern(O(1))). Then localUnit inverse followed by localFunctor(z) followed by localLine equals the comparison inverse image of the positive finite Kummer Chern arrow geoP1EtaleChern [sk-lem-geo-p1-cohomology]. This is an equation on P, with no pushforward, no completed adjunct c, and no trace. The theorem uses LocalNormalized for its displayed root-limit hypothesis and LocalChernNormalized for its displayed local equality; both are explicit predicates with precisely those formulas [def-diagonal-uniformizer-adjunct-conditions].

proof.text: Apply the finite comparison factor existence theorem to obtain k and its local-composite equality, then apply the finite Kummer identification theorem and compose the equalities.

theorem localChern
    (s : UniformizerChernNormalizationData l Y)
    (z : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l (ProjectiveLine Y) ⟶
      (DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hz : s.LocalNormalized l Y
      (SpTowerClasses.firstChern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) s.tq.chernX
        (SpTowerClasses.hyperplanePic Y)) z) : s.LocalChernNormalized l Y z
